description: The FEMA flood zone at a US street address or latitude/longitude, from the National Flood Hazard Layer: zone code (A, AE, AH, AO, V, VE, shaded or unshaded X, D), whether it is in the Special Flood Hazard Area (high risk, 1% annual chance), the base flood elevation or flood depth, the FIRM panel number and effective date, Letters of Map Revision, the NFIP community, whether flood insurance is federally required, and a link to the official FEMA map.

address.description: US street address with city and state or ZIP, e.g. "701 Bourbon St, New Orleans, LA 70116". "lat,lon" also works.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, instead of an address.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative west), with latitude.

name: flood_zone_lookup
title: Flood zone lookup by address
